cases.evidence: Transition needs information that the declared DP state does not retain.
An apparently linear loop performs an O(n) search for each of n elements and times out.
Out-of-bounds access follows from inconsistent definitions of whether a DP interval is inclusive or half-open.
Algorithm is correct, but 32-bit accumulation exceeds range under valid constraints.
Student begins implementation while state semantics are still changing, causing repeated rewrites.
